title: Dev loop: live workspace sources in Vite, document Tauri entry point
description: The dev loop silently serves stale code: workspace packages resolve via exports to compiled dist/ (packages/*/package.json), apps/desktop/vite.config.ts has no resolve.alias to src, no package has a watch script, and root pnpm dev runs only Vite — edits to package sources are invisible until a manual pnpm build, and a fresh clone fails to start (no dist). authoring-ui dist is stale right now. Fix: point Vite at package src (resolve.alias or exports development condition) or add orchestrated tsc --watch. Also: root pnpm dev launches browser-only Vite where every Tauri dialog/fs call rejects with no user-facing error — add a root script for pnpm --filter @flash/desktop tauri dev and document it as the real entry point; surface Tauri-API failures in usePublish/useFileActions instead of silent rejection.
